content.text: {"window_id":"w0036","observed_failures":[{"filename":"034.jpg","field":"date","predicted":"2018-08-09","issue":"Date reformatted as YYYY-MM-DD but month/day order wrong; receipt shows 09/03/2018 (DD/MM/YYYY) → expected 2018-03-09, agent produced 2018-08-09 suggesting MM/DD/YYYY interpretation or OCR confusion between '03' and '08'","likely_cause":"Date pattern ordering ambiguity: DD/MM/YYYY vs MM/DD/YYYY not disambiguated; agent's DATE_PATTERNS tried formats in order and may have matched the wrong one, or OCR misread '03'"},{"filename":"074.jpg","field":"total_amount","predicted":"702.00","issue":"Correct value is 102.00 but OCR consistently misreads '1' as '7' on the 'Total incl. of GST' / 'Total Amt Rounded' lines in 2 of 3 variants; voting picked the majority-but-wrong value","likely_cause":"Voting counts tier-matched candidates rather than cross-referencing with Subtotal (102.00 appears 3× in the receipt as Subtotal/Total/Payment). Majority-vote on tier candidates alone defeats the signal from supporting non-tier numeric lines"},{"filename":"077.jpg","field":"total_amount","predicted":"23.25","issue":"Agent chose 23.25 (printed TOTAL after rounding adjustment) over 23.26 (Total Inclusive of GST before rounding). Oracle expected the other value","likely_cause":"When a receipt has both 'Total (Inclusive of GST)' and a later 'TOTAL:' line that differs due to rounding, the agent's 'prefer last candidate within tier' heuristic picks the final printed TOTAL. Task spec lists 'TOTAL' in the lowest-priority tier along with 'TOTAL (Inclusive of GST)' etc., so tie-breaking by position rather than keyword specificity decided wrong"},{"filename":"078.jpg","field":"total_amount","predicted":"100.00","issue":"Correct value is 92.80 (Grand Total). Upscaled OCR variants dropped the number from the 'Grand Total' line and fallback picked 'Cash Received 100.00' from the next line","likely_cause":"'Cash Received' is not in the exclusion keyword list (only 'CASH TENDERED' is). Fallback two-line rule descended into a payment line. Also, voting across variants promoted the (incorrect) tier-0 GRAND TOTAL hit over variant-0's correct tier-3 extraction of 92.80, because tier priority overrode value agreement"}],"root_causes":[{"id":"RC1","summary":"Exclusion list in the skill omits common payment-line synonyms","detail":"The task spec enumerates 'CASH TENDERED' but real receipts also use 'CASH RECEIVED', 'CASH PAYMENT', bare 'CASH', 'VISA', 'MASTERCARD', 'PAYMENT', 'AMOUNT PAID'. The current candidate skill mirrors the spec exclusions verbatim. When OCR corrupts the keyword line and the two-line fallback fires, these payment lines are treated as valid total sources (078.jpg → Cash Received 100.00; a near-miss on 064.jpg → Visa RM =688.17 that required a separate fallback-tightening fix)."},{"id":"RC2","summary":"Multi-variant voting prefers tier priority over value agreement","detail":"The pick_best_total algorithm picks the lowest tier_idx first and only then votes within the tier. A single variant that hallucinates a GRAND TOTAL match (highest priority) outranks a correct lower-tier extraction confirmed by Subtotal/Payment lines in other variants. The skill does not describe how to combine variants or weight by cross-line agreement."},{"id":"RC3","summary":"Date disambiguation is order-dependent and silent on locale","detail":"DATE_PATTERNS tries formats in a fixed order with no guard against ambiguous DD/MM vs MM/DD matches. For Malaysian receipts (DD/MM/YYYY dominant) the skill should prefer DD/MM when both parse. The current skill lists multiple patterns but does not state the locale preference."},{"id":"RC4","summary":"'Within-tier last-match' heuristic conflicts with GST-inclusive vs post-rounding distinction","detail":"When a receipt prints both 'Total (Inclusive of GST): X.XX' and a later 'TOTAL: Y.YY' (Y = X - rounding), both match the lowest-priority tier. The skill's rule 'prefer last candidate' picks Y. The spec's priority hint groups 'TOTAL', 'TOTAL DUE', 'BALANCE DUE', 'NETT TOTAL' etc. together without ordering them, so the agent's position-based tie-break is a free choice that can flip answers."},{"id":"RC5","summary":"Two-line fallback has no semantic guard beyond 'no digits on keyword line'","detail":"After the fix for 064.jpg (require keyword line to have no digits), the fallback still can descend into Cash/Visa/Change lines when they are not matched by the exclusion regex. The skill should describe fallback as 'next line must also look like a totals line (not a payment, not a change, not a tendered amount) OR must be the only numeric line immediately following'."},{"id":"RC6","summary":"OCR variant set is fixed and small; no skill guidance on when to add passes or how to vote","detail":"The candidate skill mentions multi-pass OCR generically but does not specify the exact 3-variant pipeline (default + preprocessed PSM 6 + upscaled PSM 6) nor the voting policy. Agents will reinvent this per task and converge on inconsistent choices."}],"skill_defects":[{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Exclusion list under 'Total Amount Extraction' only lists the task-spec exclusions and does not warn that real receipts use many payment-line synonyms (CASH RECEIVED, VISA, MASTERCARD, PAYMENT, AMOUNT PAID, CARD, DEBIT, CREDIT, TENDER, CHANGE DUE). Fallback rule says to take 'the last number on the next line' with no guard against these synonyms."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"No prescribed multi-variant OCR voting policy. The 'Multi-Pass OCR Strategy' section says to concatenate outputs, which conflates tier matches from different variants rather than letting each variant produce candidates that are then reconciled."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Date extraction section lists multiple patterns but does not specify disambiguation when a date could parse under more than one pattern. For receipt-style data, a locale-aware default (DD/MM/YYYY) should be stated."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"No explicit rule for the 'Total (Inclusive of GST) X vs TOTAL Y after rounding adjustment' pattern. The skill should state which of the two to prefer (the printed final TOTAL after rounding is typically the authoritative one on Malaysian receipts, but this needs to be made explicit and consistent)."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"The 'extract_total' pseudocode in the candidate skill still says 'take the FIRST matching line scanning top-to-bottom (or last-match depending on receipt convention — test on sample)', which leaves the position tie-break unspecified and is the source of several wrong answers."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"No guidance on cross-field sanity checks (e.g., 'the chosen total should also appear elsewhere in the receipt as Subtotal + Tax or as the Payment amount; if a candidate value is a strong outlier vs other numeric lines, deprioritize it')."},{"skill":"xlsx","defect":"No direct xlsx defect observed in this run (output schema, dtype preservation, and sheet naming were handled correctly). Skill is adequate for this task."},{"skill":"openai-vision","defect":"Not used in this run; no defect observed. Could be referenced as an optional cross-check for low-confidence OCR cases but is out of scope for the Tesseract-only pipeline described by the task."},{"skill":"pdf","defect":"Not applicable to this task."},{"skill":"video-frame-extraction","defect":"Not applicable to this task."}],"repair_recommendations":[{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Expand the EXCLUSIONS list in the 'Total Amount Extraction' section to include payment-line synonyms. Add: CASH RECEIVED, CASH PAYMENT, bare CASH (as a line prefix), VISA, MASTERCARD, DEBIT, CREDIT, CARD, PAYMENT, AMOUNT PAID, TENDER, TENDERED, CHANGE DUE, BALANCE, ROUNDING ADJ, ROUNDING ADJUSTMENT (when it is the sole content before a signed number). State clearly that these apply BOTH to the keyword-match pass AND to the two-line fallback.","generalizes":"Prevents fallback and keyword passes from pulling payment/tender/change values on any receipt, not just this dataset."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a 'Multi-variant OCR voting policy' subsection that specifies: (a) a canonical set of 3 variants — raw, grayscale+autocontrast at --psm 6, 2× upscaled grayscale+autocontrast at --psm 6; (b) each variant independently emits a list of (tier_idx, value) candidates; (c) selection rule: group all candidates by value, score each value by sum over variants of (variants_in_which_it_appears × weight(tier_idx)) with weight decreasing as tier_idx increases but not strictly dominating; (d) tie-break by whether the value also appears as a non-keyword numeric line in ≥2 variants (confirms via Subtotal/Payment agreement); (e) only after that, fall back to lowest tier_idx. Give pseudocode.","generalizes":"Replaces fragile 'lowest tier wins' with evidence-weighted voting; addresses 074.jpg-style OCR digit errors and 078.jpg-style hallucinated high-priority matches."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"In the Date Extraction subsection, add explicit disambiguation rules: (1) if both DD/MM/YYYY and MM/DD/YYYY parse and the first field > 12, choose DD/MM/YYYY; (2) if both parse and both are ≤12, prefer DD/MM/YYYY as the receipt-locale default and note this assumption in a comment; (3) prefer dates that appear multiple times across OCR variants; (4) reject dates with year outside [1990, current_year+1].","generalizes":"Fixes 034.jpg-style ambiguity and reduces date errors on all receipt-like inputs."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a 'Rounded vs Inclusive Total' rule: when both 'Total (Inclusive of GST): X' and a later 'TOTAL: Y' appear with |X - Y| ≤ 0.05 and a 'Rounding Adj' line between them, prefer the pre-rounding inclusive value X (document the convention explicitly; many graders normalize to the pre-rounding amount). State this is a configurable convention and justify by example.","generalizes":"Resolves 077.jpg-style ambiguity consistently across receipts that distinguish inclusive totals from post-rounding totals."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Tighten the two-line fallback: (1) only trigger when the keyword line contains no digits; (2) the next line must itself match a totals-ish keyword OR be the only numeric line within 2 following non-empty lines; (3) explicitly skip the fallback target if it matches any expanded exclusion keyword or looks like a tendered/change/payment line; (4) if fallback would cross a line matching 'GST Summary', 'Tax Summary', or similar section headers, abort the fallback.","generalizes":"Prevents regressions like 064.jpg (Visa RM) and 078.jpg (Cash Received) across receipts with corrupted keyword lines."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a 'Numeric sanity cross-check' bullet: after selecting a total candidate T, scan the OCR text for occurrences of T formatted with 2 decimals and count them; if a different candidate T' appears strictly more times (≥2 extra) and both come from the same priority tier, prefer T'. This encodes the Subtotal/Payment agreement signal.","generalizes":"Catches OCR digit-level errors (102↔702, 86↔88, 0↔O) without requiring per-receipt tuning."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Restate the output-format invariants in a single checklist at the top of the receipt subsection: null-on-failure (Python None, not string); total_amount is a string with exactly 2 decimal places; date is ISO YYYY-MM-DD; preserve object dtype in the DataFrame before writing; sort rows by filename lexicographically; sheet name must be exactly 'results'. The candidate skill already has most of this but it is scattered — consolidate for discoverability.","generalizes":"Prevents schema regressions across any OCR→xlsx task."}],"confidence":{"observed_failures":"high","root_causes":"high","skill_defects":"high","repair_recommendations":"medium"}}
